label: GO step choosing a2 (after reaching S2), early or late in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass, never at D1, ~0 at D2) and only when the agent picks a2: model_act==2 at GO covers 98% of activations (99% of mass), but precision is only 0.19. What gates it within a2 GO steps is mostly position in the episode: rate is high in trials 0-29 and 80-99 and near zero in trials 40-79 (U-shape), and it is lower after a trial that reached S1 (prev_common==0 under a2 repeats). Magnitude is larger when the a2 logit is strongly favored (choice < -8.9 holds 53% of mass) and at low value. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own choice: dev P 0.60 R 0.83 F1 0.69 mass recall 0.94. Does not fire on a1 choices, on D1 or D2 steps, or on a2 GO steps in mid-episode. The episode-position dependence is a clean but unexplained modulation (likely slow drift in hidden state), so precision stays incomplete.
